verdict.rationale: Edge0 is an LLM inference and serving engine, so paged KV-cache management is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack never mentions paged attention, KV-cache paging, block allocation, or fragmentation control for concurrent requests. Its memory claims cover only SSD streaming of expert weights, an adjacent feature that does not transfer to KV-cache management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
